items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: Virginia gave me the record, you know, a small, a small album.

ctx.x: I really, I don't, I've only heard those records once or twice, eh?

I have, uh, I have, uh, the fact I had one, I went to somebody around here, because I haven't got a clear. I've forgotten now who I learned it to. Yeah. A fellow and, uh, the doctor, you know, and Virginia gave me the record, you know, a small, a small album. Yeah. And, uh, did you rehearse for that session? No. I hadn't paid in about a month when the nurse came to me.
I just put, put the horn up doing construction work. And they come by and asked me.
